title: On_mouse_enter and On_mouse_exited not working on instanced CharacterBody2D objects
body:
### Tested versions

-happens in Godot_v4.3-stable_win64 and Godot_v4.4-stable_win64
-doesnt happen in Godot_v4.1.2-stable_win64

### System information

Godot v4.1.2.stable - Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Compatibility) - GeForce 820M () - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-4005U CPU @ 1.70GHz (4 Threads)

### Issue description

the on_mouse_entered/exited functions does not run the code inside them when hovering the mouse over an instantiated CharacterBody2D. 

it does however, work if it is not instantiated.

```gdscript
extends CharacterBody2D

func _ready():
	input_pickable = true
	
	print("unit ready")

func _on_mouse_entered():
	print("hovered in")


func _on_mouse_exited():
	print("hovered out")

```

### Steps to reproduce

- make a scene with CharacterBody2D with CollisionShape2D as child.
- give it a script and set input_pickable to true.
- connect the on_mouse_entered and on_mouse_exited signal to the CharacterBody2D then add print output on both functions. 
- make a scene with Control with Button as child.
- give it a script and connect the _on_button_pressed signal to the Control then add to make an instance on button press.
- enable visible collision shapes in the debug menu.
- run using the Control as the main scene and press the button to instantiate CharacterBody2D scene.
-hover over the blue box.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19071562/MRP.zip)
